title: SHT40 temperature and humidity, heater disabled
summary: 3.3 V SHT40 at fixed I2C address 0x44, 100 nF bypass; uses existing carrier 10kOhm bus pull-ups at 100 kHz. Imported central copper pad explicitly omitted; physical realization pending.

datasheet.note: SHT40-AD1B: address 0x44; VDD <=3.6 V; measurement <=500 uA; no clock stretching; heater excluded from this block.

correction.note: Remove imported PAD5 central copper and paste; do not ground it. Manufacturer forbids exposed central copper/solder; die pad is not connected to any pin. Retain functional pads 1–4; final pad geometry/orientation and all exported copper/paste require native review.

datasheet.note: Actual YAGEO 100nF +/-10% 50V X7R C0603 catalog component; retained importer receipt identifies pads 1/2.

valueWhy.note: Manufacturer reference uses 100 nF X7R and two 10 kOhm pull-ups to sensor VDD. Pull-ups are supplied by the existing carrier I2C header, not duplicated here.

params.why: Heater commands are forbidden in this 2mA variant. A heater variant needs a different power budget, duty-cycle/ambient constraints and independent review (datasheet pp9,13–14).

Author default 100kHz; existing carrier has one 10kOhm +/-1% pull-up pair. Cb < tr/(0.8473 Rp), Sensirion p9; Standard-mode tr<=1000ns, NXP UM10204 Rev7 p44, https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/user-guide/UM10204.pdf . No faster-mode timing claim.

citation.note: Manufacturer reference uses 100 nF X7R and two 10 kOhm pull-ups to sensor VDD. Pull-ups are supplied by the existing carrier I2C header, not duplicated here. The <=2mm centre-distance limit is an author placement policy, not a manufacturer dimension.
SHT40-AD1B: address 0x44; VDD <=3.6 V; measurement <=500 uA; no clock stretching; heater excluded from this block.

constraints.purpose: No copper beneath sensor except functional contact pads 1–4; no central copper/paste PAD5. Exclude only sensor U1, not bypass C1. Native pad-aware exception, footprint dimensions/orientation and pours/paste remain unverified. Keep sensing opening exposed and away from heat sources.

citation.note: Remove imported PAD5 central copper and paste; do not ground it. Manufacturer forbids exposed central copper/solder; die pad is not connected to any pin. Retain functional pads 1–4; final pad geometry/orientation and all exported copper/paste require native review.

firmware.usage: Fixed address 0x44. Use Wire at 100000 Hz with shared 3.3V supply/pull-ups; do not duplicate carrier 10kOhm pull-ups. Never issue heater commands. Wait >=1ms after power-up and >=8.3ms for high-repeatability measurement (10ms policy); busy reads NACK, no clock stretching. Validate 6-byte measurement CRC-8 (polynomial 0x31, initial 0xFF). Measurement <=0.5mA plus both 10kOhm +/-1% pull-ups at 3.6V is <1.23mA; 2mA peak is author margin, not heater capacity. Actual total bus capacitance/waveforms remain unverified unless supplied and measured; 100kHz alone does not prove timing. No powered bus driving an unpowered sensor, no 5V interface. Preserve airflow, avoid warm MCU/regulator placement; no final thermal/accuracy/manufacturing claim.
